item.title: Reflecting on my time at RBC Amplify
item.description:
Through a series of miraculous strokes of luck, from being rejected to a consolation acceptance few weeks later, I ended up interning at RBC in the Amplify program this summer.

To start, I am incredibly grateful for what this summer has turned out to be. The work I did, the knowledge I learned, the mistakes I made, the people I met and the experiences I have encountered were so formative for me as not just an engineer but as a human being. In all honesty, RBC Amplify really is not your typical internship.
